subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement - FinPath
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finpath.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement - FinPath

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary use case: customer support automation for claims (high latency sensitivity for SLA-bound flows)
- Priority metrics: sub-200ms inference for short replies, embeddings for semantic search, and predictable cost for bursty traffic
- Key constraints: data residency and SOC 2 evidence requested by security/procurement teams

Next steps I suggest:
1) Schedule a 45m product demo / technical deep dive (Dev from our side to join)
2) Loop in security & procurement for a short 30m sync to review compliance artifacts and procurement timeline

Here are some demo time options (PST):
- Tue Nov 3, 10:00–10:45
- Tue Nov 3, 15:00–15:45
- Wed Nov 4, 09:30–10:15

If those don't work, feel free to pick via my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-demo

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan to help align stakeholders and a short security questionnaire you can share with your team.

[Attachment: MutualActionPlan_FP-v1.xlsx]
[Attachment: FinPath_Security_Questionnaire.pdf]

Thanks — looping Dev and our security lead after your reply to keep things moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap.

Brian (procurement) and Sonia (security) are looped here. We definitely want a technical deep dive with your dev to validate integration points, and a separate security/procurement call after that.

From our side, these times look best:
- Wed Nov 4, 09:30–10:15 (technical deep dive)
- Thu Nov 5, 11:00–11:30 (security/procurement sync)

Sonia — can you confirm if your team needs any additional artifacts beyond the questionnaire?

Alex
Head of Product, FinPath
alex.j@finpath.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement - FinPath

Perfect — thanks Alex. Looping Dev (PM, Platform Integrations) and Neha (InfoSec) from our side so we can coordinate the technical and security sessions.

Dev / Neha — proposed plan from FinPath: technical deep dive Wed Nov 4 09:30–10:15 PST; security/procurement sync Thu Nov 5 11:00–11:30 PST. Can you confirm availability?

For the technical session we'll cover:
- Integration patterns (API vs private deployment)
- Latency/throughput expectations and batching strategies
- Data flow, keys, and KV cache behavior
- Roadmap for canary + rollback policies

And for security/procurement we expect to share:
- SOC 2 report, encryption/KMS approach, data retention & deletion policies
- Contractual timelines / mutual action plan items

I've re-attached the MAP and questionnaire here for ease.

[Attachment: MutualActionPlan_FP-v1.xlsx]
[Attachment: FinPath_Security_Questionnaire.pdf]

Thanks — happy to adjust times if needed.

Best,
Marissa
